examples.name: Floating
examples.summary: The bar a dirty settings page shows: it overlays the bottom of the scroll region without moving the content, with the status sentence on the left and Discard and Save on the right.

examples.name: Docked
examples.summary: The same bar on its own row at the bottom of the region, for a layout whose scroller ends above it; the status sentence carries a muted second clause.

examples.name: Plain
examples.summary: The footer that closes a form saved as one unit: Cancel and Save on the right of the form column, always shown.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import SaveBar from '@aziontech/webkit/save-bar'
</script>

<template>
  <SaveBar kind="plain">
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        type="button"
        label="Cancel"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
      <Button
        label="Save"
        kind="primary"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </SaveBar>
</template>
